1:0x4ef75e307f7edbf0462c679192c1ff7e911c.name: f(x) Protocol - Leveraged ecosystem vault
1:0x4ef75e307f7edbf0462c679192c1ff7e911c.short: Leveraged fxSAVE yield on Morpho. Deposit USDC; the vault loops fxSAVE against USDC borrowing to amplify f(x) Protocol's savings yield, with leverage actively managed for risk-adjusted returns
1:0x4ef75e307f7edbf0462c679192c1ff7e911c.description:
**Strategy**
fxLOOP runs a leveraged USDC carry trade on f(x) Protocol yield. The vault supplies collateral on Morpho, borrows USDC against it and loops it back into collateral up to the target leverage. It earns the spread between the collateral yield and the USDC borrow rate, multiplied by the leverage. Two collateral legs, allocated to whichever offers the better carry:
- **fxSAVE**: f(x) Protocol's auto-compounding savings token backed by the fxUSD stability pool, earning a variable yield.
- **PT-fxSAVE**: the Pendle principal token of fxSAVE, locking in a fixed yield until maturity.

**Risk management**
Leverage is not fixed. The leverage is adjusted depending on the live spread between fxSAVE yield and Morpho USDC borrow rates. It adds leverage when the carry is wide and deleverages when borrow rates rise or the spread compresses. This is a high leverage vault. Any sustained fxUSD depeg could lead to liquidations.

**Key risks**
- Liquidation risk: a drop in fxSAVE's value or an oracle deviation can trigger liquidation of the Morpho position.
- Rate risk: if USDC borrow rates rise above fxSAVE yield, the carry turns negative until the position is deleveraged.
- Liquidity risk: unwinding depends on Morpho market liquidity and fxSAVE redemption, which can delay withdrawals.
- Smart contract risk across f(x) Protocol and Morpho

1:0x6a39fe461278376f61acbbb6759550e24a78.name: 9Summits Short Duration Institutional Credit — Powered by Rekord
1:0x6a39fe461278376f61acbbb6759550e24a78.short: This vault gives depositors access to short-duration institutional credit. It earns from real-world lending that generates steady, predictable cash flows not tied to crypto market. Backed by Rekord, the Provable Finance platform that brings institutional credit onchain.
1:0x6a39fe461278376f61acbbb6759550e24a78.description:
## Strategy

9Summits allocates vault capital to short-duration institutional credit. The strategy targets steady, contracted cash flows rather than market-driven returns.

[Rekord](https://www.rekord.io/)'s platform provides the infrastructure behind the strategy: risk analysis measured against industry standards and a versioned, append-only record of collateral, cash-flow and strategy data anchored on Rekord's trust layer. Depositors see the same proof surface the curator works from. That's why we call it Provable Finance.

## How it works

1. Users deposit USDC into the Lagoon vault and receive vault shares.
2. 9Summits, as curator, moves capital from the vault Safe to the whitelisted settlement address, where it is deployed under a fixed-term, fixed-payment structure.
3. Scheduled payments return to the vault in USDC.
4. The Valuation Manager updates the vault NAV on Lagoon at each valuation update using data anchored on Rekord's trust layer.
5. Deposits and redemptions are asynchronous and settled at each valuation update.

## Roles and security

| Role | Address |
|---|---|
| Owner / Curator / Security Council / Super Operator | 3/6 Safe [0x2ec0f23b52f60ce3c6406cf3fd72fb9e28016eff](https://app.safe.global/home?safe=eth:0x2ec0f23b52f60ce3c6406cf3fd72fb9e28016eff) |
| Whitelisted settlement address | Fordefi [0xC5a8b7C688aeb508cD19894c12d2f9Ef3ae753D3](https://etherscan.io/address/0xC5a8b7C688aeb508cD19894c12d2f9Ef3ae753D3) |

**Role permissions.** The 3/6 Safe runs a Zodiac Roles Modifier that restricts what the operator can execute. The role is scoped to Lagoon vault curation functions and transferring USDC from the Safe to the whitelisted settlement address only; no other targets, tokens or functions are allowed.

Permissions are public and can be inspected here: [Zodiac Roles on the vault Safe](https://app.safe.global/apps/open?safe=eth:0x2ec0f23b52f60ce3c6406cf3fd72fb9e28016eff&appUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fzodiac.gnosisguild.org%2F)

## Risks

- **Credit risk**: returns depend on offchain borrowers meeting their scheduled payments. Collateral reduces but does not eliminate loss risk.
- **Custody and counterparty risk**: capital is held and deployed outside the vault contract once it leaves the Safe.
- **Liquidity**: underlying positions are short duration but not instantly liquid. Redemptions are processed asynchronously at valuation updates.
- **Valuation**: NAV relies on portfolio data anchored on Rekord's trust layer.

## Redemptions and withdrawals

Redemptions are asynchronous: users submit a redemption request on Lagoon and receive USDC once the request is settled by the curator. Settlement time depends on the size of the request:

- **standard redemptions** require Rekord to unwind underlying credit positions and can take up to 3 weeks to settle.
- **Large redemptions** may, in extreme market conditions, take up to 3 months to be fully settled, as short-duration receivables and loans run to maturity.

1:0x6abf7b760a40c4f015803cba3cd8b430e41f.name: Mt Pelerin – HL Carry Strategies
1:0x6abf7b760a40c4f015803cba3cd8b430e41f.short: Delta-neutral carry on Hyperliquid, measured in USD
1:0x6abf7b760a40c4f015803cba3cd8b430e41f.description:
Delta-neutral carry on Hyperliquid, measured in USD. The vault holds HYPE (and potentially BTC) spot and shorts the matching perpetual in equal quantity, so price moves cancel out and the return comes from the funding paid by perp longs. The position runs on a Hyperliquid portfolio margin account: USDC is borrowed against the spot collateral to scale the trade, and a rebalancing keeps leverage within a set range as prices move. One venue, one structure, held for the long run.

Main risks: negative funding periods, Hyperliquid venue and smart-contract risk, USDC borrow availability and rates, liquidation if rebalancing fails in a sharp move.

1:0x6fd4a2bd1e879803a0e083360dddf764d0bb.name: Mt Pelerin – USD Funding Strategies
1:0x6fd4a2bd1e879803a0e083360dddf764d0bb.short: Opportunistic capture of funding rates and basis across crypto venues, measured in USD
1:0x6fd4a2bd1e879803a0e083360dddf764d0bb.description:
Opportunistic capture of funding rates and basis across crypto venues, measured in USD. The vault takes market-neutral positions wherever the spread between spot and perpetuals, or between two perpetuals, pays enough: short the expensive leg, long the cheap one. The long leg can be held as spot, perpetuals or a synthetic long built with options, whichever carries the trade most efficiently. Positions rotate as opportunities appear and fade, across several assets and venues, and may use leverage.

Venues: Hyperliquid, Lighter and Aster for perpetuals, Derive v3 for options, with more to be added over time.

Main risks: funding reversals, spread widening before convergence, execution and liquidity on the spot and options legs, roll cost at option expiry, counterparty risk on each venue used, and liquidation on leveraged legs.

1:0x7d2c2f54792ad72cb834d298f542145b06b7.name: Murmurr USDC One
1:0x7d2c2f54792ad72cb834d298f542145b06b7.short: USDC only, no other stablecoins. Morpho lending only. Capital stays in Murmurr-curated USDC Morpho Vault V2 sleeves on Ethereum, Base, HyperEVM, and Monad, with Circle CCTP as the only bridge.
1:0x7d2c2f54792ad72cb834d298f542145b06b7.description:
Murmurr USDC One is built around a fixed mandate: USDC only, Morpho only, CCTP only.

Deposit USDC and hold a single share while Murmurr allocates into its own Morpho Vault V2 sleeves on Ethereum, Base, HyperEVM, and Monad. Capital stays in Morpho USDC lending. No other loan assets. No directional market bets.

Allocation is policy-bound. Hard rules cap look-through collateral concentration (including tighter limits on non blue-chip names), keep sleeve and chain exposure diversified, and force exits when liquidity or utilization breaches thresholds. Automated safeguards filter thin, impaired, or overheated markets before capital is placed.

Markets are ranked with a risk-adjusted score that blends expected yield with collateral quality, so higher APY alone does not win. Within that framework, the allocator rotates USDC across sleeves as lending conditions shift.

When capital moves between chains, it moves with Circle CCTP only. No other bridges.

Credit Book is priced under an auditable methodology. Liquidity reserves are priced onchain.

42161:0x018282d5b510f00dcacb8f4a81c3901d.name: DACM LIT Strategy
42161:0x018282d5b510f00dcacb8f4a81c3901d.short: USDC-denominated exposure to Lighter's LLP, the liquidity provider vault powering the Lighter perp DEX. Actively managed by DACM to optimise allocation and target consistent risk-adjusted returns from market-making and liquidation fees.
42161:0x018282d5b510f00dcacb8f4a81c3901d.description:
## Overview

The DACM LIT Strategy provides USDC-denominated exposure to **Lighter's Liquidity Provider (LLP) vault** — the market-making backbone of the Lighter decentralised perpetual exchange on Arbitrum.

LLP earns yield primarily from:

- Maker rebates and trading fees from perp activity on Lighter
- Liquidation fees when leveraged traders are closed out
- Funding rate capture on the resulting market-neutral inventory

DACM actively manages the position — sizing exposure, monitoring structural metrics (notably the OI/TVL ratio as a leading indicator of fee-driven profitability), and rotating capital based on changes in vault economics.

## Why Lighter

- **Order-book DEX** with a strong CEX-like execution profile
- **Growing open interest** with maker-friendly fee structure
- **Transparent on-chain accounting** of LLP performance

## Risk Considerations

- **Smart contract risk** — Lighter protocol and Lagoon vault contracts
- **Drawdown risk** — LLP can absorb losses during adverse market events or coordinated trading flow
- **Manipulation risk** — perp LP vaults have known structural vulnerabilities under thin liquidity
- **Liquidity risk** — weekly settlement; redemptions are not instant

This vault is suitable for investors comfortable with DeFi smart contract exposure and the specific risks of perp DEX liquidity provision.

Settlement: strategy has a 3-day unlock so settles Request+3

999:0x3b65e02b1ff8072bdc094a899a4e41d07c.name: SP500 Hyperliquid Synth
999:0x3b65e02b1ff8072bdc094a899a4e41d07c.short: S&P 500 exposure on Hyperliquid. Long perp at overall target leverage 1×, idle cash earning yield in HL earn, rebalanced automatically
999:0x3b65e02b1ff8072bdc094a899a4e41d07c.description:
This vault maintains continuous long exposure to the S&P 500 via the Hyperliquid HIP-3 perpetual market [xyz:SP500](https://app.hyperliquid.xyz/trade/xyz:SP500), targeting roughly 1× notional relative to equity.

## Capital allocation (default targets)

- ~50% of equity as margin on the HIP-3 dex to collateralize the long perp
- ~50% supplied to Hyperliquid Earn to earn yield on idle cash
- Position size is scaled so notional ≈ 1.0 × total equity

## Scope of permissions
This strategy is curated by 9Summits. All permissions are public and managed onchain using [Zodiac Role Modifier](https://app.safe.global/apps/open?safe=hyper-evm:0x500d55DDbFfFEa25282D97746b68CC062ED72Bc5&appUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fzodiac.gnosisguild.org%2F). Current permissions are the following:

- Approve USDC to vault for redemptions
- Send USDC to [Fordefi HL trader address](https://debank.com/profile/0xDA6Eb6f8b8c50E0fa16d7A63C0E53174B5785909)
- Settle vault

Permission scope for address 0x500d55DDbFfFEa25282D97746b68CC062ED72Bc5 (Fordefi) are
- Trade on xyz:SP500/USDC
- Rebalance beween HL earn and Perp position

## How it works

A stateless rebalancer. It reads live on-chain state (equity, position size, mark price, margin, Earn balance). When any leg drifts beyond a small relative threshold, it:

- Adjusts the long position
- Moves USDC between default perp, spot, HIP-3 margin, and Earn to restore the target split

## Risks

- **Perpetual basis / funding:** long exposure can under- or outperform cash S&P due to funding rates and basis
- **Liquidation / margin:** although global leverage is ~1×, the position sits on a HIP-3 account with its own leverage settings (2x); large adverse moves or failed rebalances can stress margin
- **Tracking error:** maker-only execution can delay fills; the vault may temporarily deviate from target exposure
- **Smart-contract / protocol / operational risk** (Hyperliquid, Earn, bridge)

999:0x8982df557d81540678285450898f77c31d.description:
SpaceX exposure on Hyperliquid. Long perp at overall target leverage 1×, idle cash earning yield in HL earn, rebalanced automatically

## Strategy

This vault maintains continuous long exposure to SpaceX via the Hyperliquid HIP-3 perpetual market [xyz:SPCX](https://app.hyperliquid.xyz/trade/xyz:SPCX), targeting roughly 1× notional relative to equity.

## Transparency of permissions

## Capital allocation (default targets)

- ~50% of equity as margin on the HIP-3 dex to collateralize the long perp
- ~50% supplied to Hyperliquid Earn to earn yield on idle cash
- Position size is scaled so notional ≈ 1.0 × total equity

## Scope of permissions

This strategy is curated by 9Summits. All permissions are public and managed onchain using [Zodiac Role Modifier](https://app.safe.global/apps/open?safe=hyper-evm:0x5acE511748Bcd9CfA354b4B27757406Aa4bBcDCc&appUrl=https%3A%2F%2Fzodiac.gnosisguild.org%2F). Current permissions are the following:

- Approve USDC to vault for redemptions
- Send USDC to [Fordefi HL trader address](https://debank.com/profile/0xE64D3e4e0ECCac6665710989b3a6C9C512D2805D)
- Settle vault

Permission scope for address 0xE64D3e4e0ECCac6665710989b3a6C9C512D2805D (Fordefi) are

- Trade on xyz:SPCX/USDC
- Rebalance between HL earn and Perp position

## How it works

A stateless rebalancer. It reads live on-chain state (equity, position size, mark price, margin, Earn balance). When any leg drifts beyond a small relative threshold, it:

- Adjusts the long position
- Moves USDC between default perp, spot, HIP-3 margin, and Earn to restore the target split

## Live dashboard

Real-time state of the strategy is public at [spcx.9summits.io](https://spcx.9summits.io/)

## Risks

- **Perpetual basis / funding:** long exposure can under- or outperform cash SpaceX due to funding rates and basis
- **Liquidation / margin:** although global leverage is ~1×, the position sits on a HIP-3 account with its own leverage settings (2x); large adverse moves or failed rebalances can stress margin
- **Tracking error:** maker-only execution can delay fills; the vault may temporarily deviate from target exposure
- **Single-name / HIP-3 market:** SPCX is a synthetic equity perp (not the Nasdaq share). Availability, oracle, and market parameters depend on the HIP-3 deployer
- **Smart-contract / protocol / operational risk** (Hyperliquid, Earn, bridge)
